title: Fast-Path Onboarding and Guaranteed Export Lanes for High-Touch Tenants
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem statement: High-touch enterprise customers repeatedly request bespoke CSV/Parquet exports and detailed token-level cost reports. Current requests are funneled through standard reporting intake queues and suffer unpredictable SLAs. This creates churn for solutions and account teams and blocks customers from shipping billing-sensitive dashboards.

Goal: Define a lightweight 'fast-path' intake and delivery lane for verified high-value tenants that guarantees delivery SLAs for small-to-medium exports (<= 10M rows or <= 10GB), provides an automated cost preview, and offers an optional engineering-backed delivery route. The feature should be policy-driven so the Console can route requests automatically once eligibility criteria are met.
proposed_solution:
1) Eligibility checks: workspace tier + active contract threshold + support health signal. 2) Fast-path UI: a single-step request form in Console -> Export > Fast-Path Export with predefined templates (usage summary, token cost breakdown, per-route breakdown). 3) Automated preflight cost estimator using sampled telemetry to show expected compute cost and estimated turnaround. 4) Guaranteed lane: if request qualifies, it receives a committed delivery SLA (72 hours for templated exports). 5) Engineering delivery: small exports are auto-run by the export service; larger or custom formats open a ticket to a delivery pool with SLO. 6) Audit and billing hooks: export metadata written to audit logs and associated with billing connectors. 7) Admin controls: tenant admins can opt-in/out to fast-path and configure recipients.

UI mocks, sample SQL templates, and the preflight estimator algorithm will be in Confluence link (see links).
acceptance_criteria: Console shows a 'Fast-Path Export' option for eligible tenants
Eligibility is computed server-side and matches documented policy (tier + commit + support-health)
Preflight estimator renders an approximate cost with +/-20% accuracy for sampled workloads
Templated exports <= 10M rows complete within 72 hours 95% of the time in staging
Export requests create audit entries and surface downstream billing labels
Admin toggle in Console to enable/disable Fast-Path per workspace
tradeoffs:
- Faster delivery requires tighter eligibility; broad eligibility increases operational load.
- Providing precise cost estimates requires sampling which may be misleading for bursty tenants. We choose a conservative estimator (+20% buffer).
- Guaranteed SLA for templated exports could require reserved processing capacity or prioritization policy; this may increase infra costs for Dedicated customers. We propose a soft quota (per-tenant monthly fast-path units) for initial rollout.
work_items: Define eligibility policy and edge cases (PM)
Build preflight estimator service and sampling pipeline (ENG)
Implement export prioritization queue and SLA tracking (ENG)
Add audit/billing labels and connector hooks (ENG)
Create Console admin toggle and feature flag (ENG)
Document runbook for manual delivery lane (Support)
Create sellable packaging and rate limits with GTM (Sales/Product)
E2E tests and canary rollout plan (QA/Eng)
